name: Primal Brilliant Silver
tooltip:
Primal Brilliant Silver
5 yd range
2.5 sec cast
A higher grade of silver, Brilliant Silver's shine is as unmatched as its magical conductive properties. It is highly sought after as the epitome of form and function.

Harandar pulses with the magic of life itself. Gathering an ore deposit filled with this magic will replenish a portion of abilities for your Skyriding mount.

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
